sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000149-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Summit Wellness Center 149 on August 2, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,400 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
